issues.description: Method Developer.attend: the problem statement and template declare an instance method with the signature func attend(course: Course?) (single optional Course parameter). In the solution repository the method signature is func attend(course: Course?, forCredit: Bool) — an extra Boolean parameter. The solution's Client.swift calls myself.attend(course: swiftCourse) with a single argument, which does not match the solution method signature and would cause a compilation error or confusion for students about the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's Developer.attend method signature match the problem statement and template by removing the extra parameter: declare func attend(course: Course?) { ... } and update its implementation accordingly. Alternatively, if the extra parameter is intentional, update the problem statement and the template to document the additional parameter and update all call sites; or give the new parameter a default (e.g. forCredit: Bool = false) so existing single-argument calls (Client.main and student code) remain valid.
